pkgmetadata.longdescription: Google's V8 JavaScript and WebAssembly engine, version 15.4.64. Packaging follows AUR v8-r (GN component build, system ICU, system Clang, d8 plus shared libraries and pkg-config files) with the extra git DEPS V8 15 requires (abseil, partition_alloc, highway, and so on). CIPD/GCS toolchains are not used: gn, ninja, lld, and clang come from Gentoo. Temporal/Rust support is off so the bundled Rust sysroot is not required. The V8 sandbox is disabled because it demands hardened libc++, which conflicts with linking against libstdc++.
